name: Tides of Oneiric Darkness
body:
School evocation [darkness, mind-affecting]; Level adept 3, antipaladin 3, bard 3, cleric/oracle 3, death mage 3, inquisitor 3, lathspell 3, legendary ninja 3, magus 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3
Saving Throw Will negates, see text; Spell Resistance yes, see tex.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as the spell darkness except in addition to the darkness, any creature beginning their turn in or entering the area of darkness must make .

Will save or fall asleep as per the spell sleep for 1 minute.

The darkness does not have an HD limit but does not affect creatures with HD higher than 4. Once a creature falls asleep or succeeds on their saving throw, they are immune to the sleep effect for 1 minute. The saving throw and spell resistance only apply to the sleep effect.

Tides of Oneiric Darkness, Greater

School evocation [darkness, mind-affecting]; Level adept 5, antipaladin 4, bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, death mage 5, inquisitor 5, lathspell 4, legendary ninja 4, magus 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch .

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as tides of oneiric darkness, except that its darkness is increased to the effect produced by deeper darkness and the spell effects creatures up to 8 HD.
